rate_limits: 1,000 API calls/hour and 5,000 calls/day per consumer key (additional IP- and action-specific limits may apply)
resolution_notes: Auditor right on rate_limits. Official Tumblr Developer Resources (help.tumblr.com/knowledge-base/developer-resources/) publishes defaults: 1,000 API calls/hour and 5,000/day per consumer key, plus IP- and action-specific limits. Original "not published" is incorrect.
